title: Suppress cron job email output
summary: Prevent cron from sending emails for every job by redirecting output to /dev/null or setting MAILTO.

steps.explain: Edit your crontab to add redirection to the end of your command line.
In the editor, append '>/dev/null 2>&1' to the end of the command line for the job you want to silence. For example: '0 1 * * * /path/to/script.sh >/dev/null 2>&1'. Save and exit.
